feature: Progress synchronization preserves clipping and highlight edits through commit and journal reopen
checks: Shared reader sync fixtures now contain a saved highlighted page excerpt
Create and download retain the excerpt, its highlight flag, source range, text and timestamp in reopened journals
Changing highlight state or removing an excerpt after exchange and adding another highlighted excerpt survives completion commit and journal reopen
Progress position and checkpoint still update to the expected remote record
Stale and cancelled completions, persistence errors and checkpoint reset preserve annotated state through existing whole-state and framebuffer assertions
Torn newest journal recovery retains the prior complete annotated state
limits: Tests use the shared reader/session implementation and synthetic HTTP responses; annotation-specific native/device input and independent tailnet exchanges are not qualified here.
No production code changes or firmware rebuild in this checkpoint.
Clippings and highlights remain local state; the progress protocol does not synchronize annotations between readers.
